description: The pie chart, titled "Answer Types," displays the distribution of different types of questions in the MathOdyssey benchmark dataset. The chart is divided into three primary segments: a large green section representing "Open-Answer" questions, which account for 63.0% of the total (244 instances); an orange section for "Multi-Choice" questions, making up 32.8% (127 instances); and a small blue section for "True-False" questions, comprising 4.1% (16 instances). Each segment is labeled with its category name, the corresponding percentage, and the count of questions. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of open-answer problems, with the green slice being significantly larger than the other two. A legend is not explicitly shown, but the labels are directly placed next to their respective slices. The chart is accompanied by examples of each question type on the right side, illustrating the format of problems in the benchmark.
